title: Caveman drifts back to natural prose mid-session. Articles/filler/full sentences leak after ~3-5 turns despite SessionStart + UserPromptSubmit hooks firing every turn with banner.
body:
Expected
  Mode persists every response until session end or stop caveman. No drift in long context. No excuse via auto-clarity carve-out.

  Before/after example
  Input: did u replace figma skill?
  Got:   "Yes. Replaced earlier this session: Old `.claude/skills/figma-to-compose/` moved → `figma-to-compose.bak.<ts>`. New extracted from `Downloads/figma-to-compose (3).skill` zip → `.claude/skills/figma-to-compose/`. Backup deleted after you confirmed. Skill list now shows new `figma-to-compose` (16 files:
  SKILL.md, 6 references, 8 scripts, test.js). Active version. New SKILL.md description hardened — auto-triggers on any Figma URL + Kotlin/Compose signal."
  Want:  "Yes. Old → .bak. New extracted. Backup deleted. 16 files. Active."

  Platform
  - Claude Code


  Version / install method
  - Plugin marketplace install via oh-my-claudecode
  - Plugin path: ~/.claude-account1/plugins/cache/caveman/caveman/84cc3c14fa1e
  - Mode: full (config: ~/.config/caveman/config.json = {"defaultMode":"full"})
  - Model: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context)
  - Hooks verified firing: SessionStart ✓ UserPromptSubmit ✓
